bio: Prof. Dr. Rabindra L. Pradhan is a Consultant Orthopaedic Spine Surgeon with PhD in Orthopaedics and over 33 years of experience in advanced spine surgery.

name: Dr. Jitendra Thakur
bio: Dr. Jitendra Thakur is an Associate Consultant in Orthopaedic and Spine Surgery specializing in advanced spinal care and minimally invasive techniques.

name: Dr. Niva Chitrakar
qualification: MBBS, MS, Fellowship in Hand & Upper Extremity Surgery
bio: Dr. Niva Chitrakar is an Orthopaedic and Trauma Surgeon specializing in musculoskeletal injuries, bone fractures, joint disorders, and complex trauma.

name: Dr. Manju Gyawali
bio: Dr. Manju Gyawali leads the Department of Physiotherapy and Rehabilitation at Nepal Mediciti with over 14 years of experience in neurological rehabilitation and pain management.
